title: Put a hand on your chest and say one kind sentence to yourself, the way you'd say it to a friend.
why: Self-kindness is linked to more resilience, not less drive.

title: Walk outside for 20 minutes, no headphones.
why: Walking in green places quiets the replaying thoughts.

title: Keep your phone in another room for the first 30 minutes after you wake up.
why: A slower start gives your attention back to you.

title: Write down three things that went well today, and why.
why: Noticing what went right, a few nights in a row, lifts mood for weeks.

title: Tidy one small corner: a drawer, a desk, a shelf. Stop at 15 minutes.
why: Small, finished tasks are an antidote to feeling stuck.

title: Block two hours with nothing productive in them. Protect them like a meeting.
why: Real rest is how you recover, not a reward for finishing.
